_comment: One entry per conference. `corpus` is the single most important field: it says what the visible papers actually are, because that changes what every chart means. Check it with scripts/fetch.py --probe before trusting a new venue. `caveats` are per-venue method-section rows; the site renders whichever are present, so a venue never inherits another's claims.

iclr.corpus_note: ICLR publishes every submission, so counts measure what the field submits.
iclr.name: ICLR

caveats.Label quality: Measured on 60 ICLR papers whose titles name a concept unambiguously: 100% of those concepts were recovered. 12% of all predicted labels had no matching phrase in the paper text - some are legitimate synonyms, some are wrong. Treat per-concept counts as accurate to a few percent, not exact.
caveats.The broad bucket: “Benchmarks & evaluation (broad)” is the largest concept and the least precise. It catches papers that release a benchmark AND papers that merely evaluate something, so it overstates benchmark releases. Read it as “does evaluation work”, not “ships a benchmark”. The revised taxonomy in topics.json narrows this, and has not been applied to these labels.
caveats.Not shown: Acceptance rates for 2027: no decisions have been released. Withdrawal rates: withdrawals accumulate until decisions, so 2027's figure is not comparable with a finished year's.

iclr.citations_note: OFF: ICLR submissions are under review and unpublished, so true counts are zero and a title lookup mostly returns the wrong paper.

neurips.corpus_note: NeurIPS publishes accepted papers plus a small opted-in minority of rejections (~5%). Counts measure what was ACCEPTED, not what was submitted. Acceptance rates and withdrawal rates cannot be computed. NeurIPS also changed its rating scale between 2024 (1-10) and 2025 (1-6); scores are not comparable across those years.
neurips.name: NeurIPS

caveats.Label quality: Measured on 55 NeurIPS papers whose titles name a concept unambiguously: 96% of those concepts were recovered, and 9% of predicted labels had no matching phrase in the paper text. Treat per-concept counts as accurate to a few percent, not exact.
caveats.Not shown: Acceptance rates and withdrawal rates: rejected and withdrawn submissions are not public at NeurIPS, so there is no denominator to compute them from.
caveats.Comparing with the ICLR page: These labels were made under the 84-concept taxonomy; the ICLR page's were made under an earlier 73-concept one. Each page is internally consistent, but concept shares are not strictly comparable between the two.

neurips._pending: NeurIPS 2026: the group and a now-expired submission invitation exist, but zero notes are public as of 2026-11-11 and the group does not set public_submissions. NeurIPS publishes accepted papers around the conference (December 2026). Re-probe then and add 2026 to `years`.

icml.corpus_note: As NeurIPS. ICML 2024 and earlier carry no keywords, primary_area or public reviews, so they are excluded.
icml.name: ICML

caveats.Not shown: Acceptance rates and withdrawal rates: rejected and withdrawn submissions are not public at ICML.

icml._pending: ICML 2026 is public and carries abstracts, keywords, primary_area and authors, but NO reviews as of 2026-11-11 - so a report on it would have topic charts and no score sections. ICML 2024 and earlier carry no keywords or primary_area at all.
